rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Makhluk campuran keledai-babi dari definisi bestiarium, tanpa memadukan varian toga Tertullian.

visual_requirements.description: Satu monster setengah keledai setengah babi; telinga keledai panjang serta moncong dan bulu kaku babi; empat kaki berkuku sebagai rekonstruksi editorial gabungan hewan.

aura: Ancaman melalui keganjilan gabungan setengah keledai setengah babi (onocoete-c01/c03), tanpa aura gaib.
artistic_choices: Varian bestiarium c01/c03 dipilih secara terpisah dari varian toga c04/c07. Riset c02/c06 secara eksplisit menyebut konteks desas-desus pagan dan tuduhan fitnah kuno terhadap orang Kristen; ilustrasi adalah rekonstruksi monster dalam rumor historis itu, bukan gambaran faktual Tuhan agama apa pun.
Pembagian unsur kedua hewan, warna gelap, ruang netral, cahaya samping dan gerak menerjang adalah pilihan ilustratif. Ukuran tidak dibesarkan; framing dekat.
Tidak ada kekuatan atau habitat terdokumentasi; tidak ada efek gaib maupun lokasi spesifik.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka bestiary illustration of Onocoete, the half-donkey half-pig hybrid monster from an old bestiary definition, entirely fictional and unrelated visually to any religious figure.
ANATOMY: exactly one head combining a long donkey facial structure with a blunt pig snout, two long upright donkey ears, two eyes, a heavy bristled pig torso, four sturdy hoofed legs and one short tail. Hybrid proportions are an original interpretation of half donkey half pig [onocoete-c01, onocoete-c03].
MOMENT: driving forward toward the viewer, snout thrust very close, hoof lifted, ears raked backward, tense mouth open.
POWER: no documented power; menace through clearly hybrid anatomy, movement and light only.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle ground-level close view, creature fills almost all the square; no invented giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm side light, hard rim on bristles, deep brown shadows, ordinary dust at its moving hooves.
SURFACE: coarse donkey hair mixed with pig bristles, leathery muddy snout, worn dark hooves.
SETTING: unobtrusive dark neutral ground, no specific habitat asserted.
MOOD: uncanny, dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads or limbs; no horns, wings, human parts, toga, book or religious symbols; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_review.notes: Native dan 200px: kepala campuran moncong babi/telinga keledai terbaca; tubuh menerjang dan empat kaki berkuku tanpa tambahan; tidak ada efek gaib, teks, bingkai atau figur agama. Tujuh Uji Sangar ya.
